content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
SyscacheFileInUse
File referenced in Syscache record is in use, i.e., has not been deleted.
MftRecordId
Index number in sector header area of Windows Master File Table record.
MftSequenceNumber Windows Master File Table (MFT) sequence number.
SHA1HashData
The SHA1 hash of a file.  In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.
USN
UsnJournalId
Update Sequence Number (USN) Journal identifier for each change record in Windows NTFS volume. Each record in the Change Journal
contains the USN, the name of the file, and information about what the change was.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
FfcFileIdentifier
24-byte concatenation of a filesystem volume's UUID and a file's inode value.
ProgramUUID
Hash of the windows program name, the version, the publisher and the language. This value is identical across different systems: the
same version of a software installed on two different machines results in the same value.
